metadata.neutral_citation: NG KWOK WING v. LAU PING KWAN AND OTHERS [1996] HKCFI 236; [1996] 4 HKC 667; HCPI 1013/1995 (23 May 1996)
metadata.case_name: NG KWOK WING v. LAU PING KWAN AND OTHERS

injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified intrathoracic organs
Fracture of other specified part of lower leg, including ankle

injuries.description: fracture of T-12 of the thoracic vertebrae and L-1 of the lumbar vertebrae
source: (4) fracture of T-12 of the thoracic vertebrae and L-1 of the lumbar vertebrae.

injuries.description: extensive infection of the right hip, complicated by tuberculosis involvement of the right hip
source: There was extensive infection of the right hip which was identified in 1993.
The infection of the right hip was further complicated by tuberculosis involvement of the right hip.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the hip or thigh

injuries.body_part: both lower limbs / spinal cord injury
source: Because of the fracture of the T-12 and L-1, the Plaintiff is now a paraplegic and can only move on a wheelchair.
injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of lumbar spinal cord

manifestations.description: lost movements of both lower limbs
loss of sensation at both lower limbs
severe wasting of muscles of both legs
total loss of reflexes in his lower limbs
great pain at his lower limbs
incontinence of the bladder and bowel
needs catheterisation and diapers; drains his bladder through self-catherization
bowels do not work unless a suppository is used every other day
stiffness on the movement of the right shoulder after prolong immobility
urinary tract infections (recurrent); re-admitted in 1993 and treated by intravenous anti-biotics; persistent fever and deep enlarged sacral sore with pus discharge

treatments_received: surgeries for fractured bones (immediately after the accident)
debridgement and drainage of abscess (three occasions between May and June 1993)
intravenous antibiotics (for urinary tract infection in 1993)
retrieval of two pieces of plain short gauzes from the right hip joint during operation
trial of transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulator (TENS)
treatments_future: psychiatric treatment (drug treatment and supportive psychotherapy for two years as recommended)
periodic in-patient psychiatric treatment (average four weeks per year as potential future need)

losses.description: Lost movements of both lower limbs; can only move on a wheelchair.
Needs support for his lower limbs while transferring between the bed and wheelchair; requires catheterisation and diapers; requires a domestic helper and nursing assistance.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life

losses.description: Loss of roles as a bread-winner, husband and father; family psychosocial and psychiatric problems arising from the injury.

Major depressive disorder and adverse psychological reactions including unresolved grief, very low self esteem, feeling of inadequacy, restricted interest and activities and institutionalized way of life.
Life expectancy reduced by about 10% (from about 35 years to about 30 years) because of recurrent urinary tract infection and pressure sores; impairment of kidney function may occur.
